purpose: Machine-readable registry of the directive Section 9 test matrix (T01-T27) plus the Section 18 additions (T28-T34). Every row names its subject items, its state on this base, the evidence files that implement it today, and, for work that cannot exist yet, the owning item it waits on. Validated by tests/check_matrix.py and tests/unit/test_matrix_registry.py. A row is 'implemented' only when its evidence files exist and its good/bad pair runs today; 'partial' when a named part runs today and the rest is owned by a later item; 'pending' when the subject does not exist yet. No row may be reported as passing on the strength of this registry alone: the registry points at evidence, it is not evidence.

states.implemented: The test runs today against subjects that exist on this base; evidence files are listed and exist.
states.partial: A named part runs today (evidence listed); the remainder is owned by the items in blocked_on.
states.pending: The subject does not exist on this base yet; blocked_on names the owning item(s). No acceptance is claimed.
